channel.title: 4PLANET MAGAZINE
channel.description: Stories about the living planet — species, places, people, systems, solutions and culture.

item.title: Why 4Planet exists
item.description: People care about the living world. What they rarely have is a clear, credible way to act.

item.title: The four Domains
item.description: One living planet, read through four connected worlds — ocean, land, human systems and culture.

item.title: WH4LES: the intelligence that travels through whole oceans
item.description: A whale is not a single animal in empty water. It is part of the ocean's living infrastructure.

item.title: What a credible tree pathway actually looks like
item.description: Planting the wrong thing in the wrong place can look like climate action while doing very little.

item.title: AM4ZONIA: more than a forest
item.description: The Amazon is closer to planetary infrastructure than to scenery.

item.title: Making impact easy — without making it fake
item.description: The hard part is not generosity. It is trust. 4Planet is built around that problem.
